name: dumbbell incline fly (palms forward)
description: An incline dumbbell fly with the palms facing forward. The arms open wide and nearly straight, then sweep back together over the chest to work the upper chest.
instructions: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and sit back against it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest, palms facing forward, arms nearly straight.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Squeeze your chest to sweep the dumbbells back up until they meet over your chest, palms still facing forward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
